title: How do you pay for an instance?
claim: Licensing, tolerance for interruption and steady use decide how you pay for an instance.
alt: A decision ladder with three questions. Licenses bound to sockets or cores lead to Dedicated Hosts; work that can stop and restart leads to Spot Instances; steady use for one or three years leads to a Savings Plan; everything else leads to On-Demand.
